instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.definition: An decrease in the probability of an event occurring, as compared to a background risk such as the normal risk in a given population. For instance, limiting alcohol consumption can decrease risk of ovarian cancer.

items.label: mosaic loss of chromosome X measurement
items.definition: It is the most common clonal somatic alteration in leukocytes of female individuals.

items.label: socioeconomic status
items.definition: Characteristics of a person such as education and occupation, used to describe the person's position in stratification systems, access to services, etc.

items.label: Genetic perturbation
items.definition: A genetic manipulation of nucleic acid sequences by mutation, insertion or deletion of nucleotides, or by altering the expression of genes.

items.label: preserved ratio impaired spirometry
items.definition: It is defined as forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV1) <80% predicted and FEV1/forced vital capacity (FVC) ratio ≥0.70.

items.label: social risk factor
items.definition: Social factors such as personal behavior, lifestyle, or environment belonging to the subject which are known to increase the likelihood of infection and disease.

items.label: labor and delivery complications
items.definition: The occurrence of a pregnancy complication during childbirth, which includes both labor (the process of childbirth) and delivery (the birth itself).

items.label: neonatal injury related to birth

items.label: income

items.label: GATA1 gene mutation

items.label: Salmon quantification of Slide-seq data

items.definition: A quantification of the degree of mitochondrial heteroplasmy, i.e. the presence of different mitochondrial DNA variants in different mitochondria within the same individual organism or cell. Heteroplasmy can be inherited through the maternal germ line, or arise through somatic mitochondrial mutation

items.label: hemoglobin change measurement

items.label: plasma leucine rich alpha-2-glycoprotein 1 measurement

items.label: ABO blood group
items.definition: The ABO system consists of A and B antigens and antibodies against these antigens.

items.label: blood group A
items.definition: ABO phenotype A, corresponding to the genotype AO or AA.

items.label: blood group B
items.definition: ABO phenotype B, corresponding to the genotype BO or BB.

items.label: blood group AB
items.definition: ABO phenotype AB, corresponding to the genotype AB.

items.label: blood group O
items.definition: ABO phenotype O, corresponding to the genotype OO.

items.label: mastiha supplement exposure measurement
